rules: Only CURRENT_CONTRACT, CURRENT_REGRESSION, and EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY modules may be canonically discovered (tests/test_*.py) or registered to a CI group. HISTORICAL_ONLY and OBSOLETE records describe REMOVED units only.

Historical provenance is not a retention criterion; Git history is the archive. An accepted manifest, producer-hash ledger, historical script, or old issue that names a test path never keeps that test alive.
Only HISTORICAL_ONLY or OBSOLETE units may leave canonical discovery/CI, and every removed module names what protects its evidence (replacement).

An accepted row file (MANIFEST.sha256, CLOSURE.sha256, JSON producer-hash ledger) that names a removed test file keeps its bytes; docs/ci/retired-test-rows.json records one exact tombstone per retired row (manifest path, manifest sha256, target path, stored target sha256, reason, Issue #246 authority). No wildcard or prefix retirement exists.
overrides classify mixed modules at Class or Class.test_method granularity; a retained unit must itself be current.

pinned_by_evidence: for a retained module, the accepted MANIFEST.sha256 rows that bind its bytes; for a removed module, exactly the row files carrying its retired-row tombstones. named_by_evidence lists other evidence that only names the path (historical provenance, verified by nothing).

referenced_by_scripts lists scripts that import the test module or name its file; the checker derives it and fails if the record omits one. For a removed module every such script must be a byte-frozen retired producer pinned in docs/ci/retired-lineage-pins.sha256, and no script may import it.
test_count_at_audit is the discovered count when the audit was produced; it is informational, not enforced.
